decisions.reason: Assigning the Business category to Article 9 does not change the requirement to display the correct author name and photo or their placement.
The Article 9 category mapping does not change the required shape or size of author photos.
The category assigned to Article 9 does not affect the separate color restriction for the Dorian Vale article.
Identifying Article 9 and its category does not alter the requirement to source article content from the Civic Lantern website.
The Article 9 category mapping does not modify the magazine's polished, modern, brand-aligned visual style.
The category assignment for one article does not change the digital flipbook PDF deliverable.
The Article 9 category mapping does not change the requirement to enhance image quality when necessary.
The Article 9 category mapping does not alter or resume the deferred print-ready output requirement.
